builds.name: Reference: AD spell pressure
builds.goal: Reference for Hecarim: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A momentum-based diver who maintains Rampage stacks, enters with speed and heals while dealing damage in a clustered fight. Fix Rampage stacks and approach speed, then measure AD conversion and W recovery. Movement-only spending must improve real engagement damage instead of just the movement-speed display. AD, haste and Black Cleaver may reward repeated physical ability hits.
testPlan: Kit question for Hecarim: Fix Rampage stacks and approach speed, then measure AD conversion and W recovery. Movement-only spending must improve real engagement damage instead of just the movement-speed display.

Start with the early core (Eclipse, then Shojin) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: AD, haste and Black Cleaver may reward repeated physical ability hits. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Hecarim cleaves nearby enemies dealing physical damage. If Hecarim damages at least one enemy, he increases the damage and lowers the cooldown of subsequent Rampages. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
